prompt.alinti: This is how to turn Claude into a system that automatically improves itself.
Every conversation you have is saved by Claude, but not just in their database, it's also stored on your computer.
So this is why twice a week, I run one skill called /improve-system.
It looks at my conversation history and tells me what I'm doing wrong, what Claude skills I should create.
But here's my favorite part. It flags the things I do every day that normally takes hours
and suggests how to make automations that can run it in minutes.
So I'm not sitting there asking what skill should I build.
It finds it in my sessions and then writes it for me.
Now to enable this, all you have to do is install the free buildpartner.ai plugin inside Claude. And once it's installed, you run slash improve system and it's ready to go.
So if you want me to send you the plugin and a walkthrough to get this running on your setup, comment improve and I'll send it over for free.
